arabic text: MAATAM HAY AAJ ASKARI SHAHR ZISHAN KA
english translation text: TODAY WE LAMENT FOR THE GLORIOUS IMAM HASSAN ASKARI (A.S.)

arabic text: MAATAM HAY AAJ ASKARI SHAHR ZISHAN KA\nURYAN SAR HAY AAJ IMAME ZAMAAN KA
english translation text: TODAY WE LAMENT FOR THE GLORIOUS IMAM HASSAN ASKARI,\nON THIS DAY, IMAM ZAMANA IS GRIEF STRICKEN

arabic text: JAB ZEHR KE SADME SE TADAPNE LAGE SARWAR\nNAZEON MEI THA VO WAKEYA TASWIRE HASSAN KA
english translation text: WHEN THE EFFECTS OF THE POISON MADE, THE IMAM TREMBLE WITH PAIN,\nTHIS BROUGHT BACK REMEMBRANCE OF THE DEATH OF THE SECOND HOLY IMAM HASAN

arabic text: RONE SE HASHRA HOGAYA SAB JINNO BASHAR ME\nTABUT UTHA JAB KE SHAHE DO JAHAN KA
english translation text: THE MOURNING STARTED AMONGST ALL THE CREATION- JINN AND HUMAN,\nWHEN THE BODY OF THE MASTER OF THE HEAVENS AND EARTH WAS LIFTED
